Name: Pelicans Bring Babies
Author: Xaneathmar
Description:
I wanted to use the adorable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7208]Pelican Children[/url] mod by chatondoux, but technical issues have prevented it from working properly since 1.5 released back in 2020! This is mostly just an update to future-proof the mod, but I also wrote a few new alternate lines–your spouse will have something slightly different to say if this is your second child.

As with the original mod, the purpose of this mod is to make Stardew Valley more inclusive without changing the underlying mechanics. I think of it as being kind of like a spider replacer for people with arachnophobia? Adoption for queer couples can be an upsetting topic for many different reasons and this alternative appealed most to me; you might also consider [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20743]Pregnancy Choice[/url] for a 1.6-compatible option to make any gender of spouse or farmer pregnant, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5762]Pregnancy Role[/url] if it gets an update. Personally, I like the whimsy of using pelicans, and it still fits nicely with Stardew's more mystical elements.

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/chatondoux/about-me]chatondoux [/url]for making the original mod! I might revisit this later to give Jas, Vincent, and Leo a couple extra lines just because it'd be cute, but this is going to be all for now. I hope you like it!

Downloads.Description: Initial release! All types of couples will have the same dialogue surrounding pregnancy, including fresh lines for the second baby.

Manifest.Name: Pelicans Bring Babies
Manifest.Description: Babies are delivered by a pelican rather than born or adopted. Revival of the Pelican Children mod by Chatondoux.
Manifest.Author: Xaneathmar
